spec.name: Rear wing
spec.role: rear wing: main plane, flap, endplates, central support
spec.notes: Main plane chord 350 at Z ~870-905, X -4400 to -4050, span 1000 between endplates; one flap chord 200 above/behind with slot gap (Z ~930-1000). Two endplates 20 thick, Z 700-1100, X -4450 to -3950 at Y ±500..±520. Two simplified support plates (20 thick in Y, centred Y=±100) from front face at X=-3700 (touching monocoque rear face, Z 400-730 region) sweeping rearward up to the main plane underside. Clear of floor diffuser (max Z 230).

script_body:
def foil_plan(xf, c, w, t, yc, z):
    # slim aerodynamic plan section: flat front at xf, widest just behind it, thin tail
    return [(xf, yc - w / 2.0, z), (xf, yc + w / 2.0, z), (xf - 0.35 * c, yc + w / 2.0, z),
            (xf - c, yc + t / 2.0, z), (xf - c, yc - t / 2.0, z), (xf - 0.35 * c, yc - w / 2.0, z)]


def build(part):
    span = part.p["span"]
    ept = part.p["endplate_thickness"]
    st = part.p["support_thickness"]
    sy = part.p["support_spacing"] / 2.0

    # Main plane: cambered airfoil, rounded leading edge at front (+X), 4 mm trailing edge
    sk = part.sketch(part.plane("y", 0), "SK_mainplane")
    mp = [(-4050, 962), (-4054, 971), (-4066, 978), (-4085, 982), (-4150, 985), (-4250, 988),
          (-4350, 993), (-4400, 1000), (-4400, 996), (-4300, 972), (-4200, 958), (-4120, 950),
          (-4085, 950), (-4065, 952), (-4054, 956)]
    part.polygon(sk, [(x, 0, z) for x, z in mp])
    part.extrude(part.profile(sk), "span", "EX_mainplane", symmetric=True)

    # Flap: cambered airfoil above/behind the main plane, ~20-24 mm slot gap
    skf = part.sketch(part.plane("y", 0), "SK_flap")
    fp = [(-4250, 1012), (-4254, 1021), (-4266, 1028), (-4330, 1042), (-4400, 1062),
          (-4450, 1080), (-4450, 1076), (-4400, 1052), (-4330, 1026), (-4280, 1013), (-4262, 1009)]
    part.polygon(skf, [(x, 0, z) for x, z in fp])
    part.extrude(part.profile(skf), "span", "EX_flap", op="join", symmetric=True)

    # Endplates: swept, slightly curved leading edge, rounded top corners, shallow lower-rear cut-out
    yin = span / 2.0 - ept
    ep = [(-3958, 700), (-3952.3, 702.3), (-3950, 708), (-3972, 880), (-4010, 1060),
          (-4016, 1080), (-4030, 1094), (-4050, 1100), (-4430, 1100), (-4443, 1095),
          (-4450, 1085), (-4450, 765), (-4446, 752), (-4436, 745), (-4300, 745),
          (-4262, 736), (-4228, 716), (-4200, 702), (-4185, 700)]
    skl = part.sketch(part.plane("y", yin), "SK_endplate_L")
    part.polygon(skl, [(x, yin, z) for x, z in ep])
    part.extrude(part.profile(skl), ept, "EX_endplate_L", op="join")
    skr = part.sketch(part.plane("y", -yin), "SK_endplate_R")
    part.polygon(skr, [(x, -yin, z) for x, z in ep])
    part.extrude(part.profile(skr), -ept, "EX_endplate_R", op="join")

    # Supports: unchanged contact block at X=-3700 (Z 400..500, 20 thick), then a slim plate
    # leaning rearward and tapering (20 -> 12 mm) into the main plane underside
    for nm, yc in (("L", sy), ("R", -sy)):
        base = part.section("z", 400, foil_plan(-3700, 130, st, 6, yc, 400), "SK_support_base_" + nm)
        part.extrude(base, 100, "EX_support_base_" + nm, op="join")
        s0 = part.section("z", 500, foil_plan(-3700, 130, st, 6, yc, 500), "SK_support_low_" + nm)
        s1 = part.section("z", 975, foil_plan(-4120, 160, 12, 4, yc, 975), "SK_support_top_" + nm)
        part.loft([s0, s1], "LF_support_" + nm, op="join")

history.summary: Cambered main plane and flap profiles with a ~20 mm slot gap, tapered supports leaning rearward, swept endplates with a cut-out, rounded profile corners
history.instruction:
Refine the rear wing for a more realistic look without changing any contact, envelope or mounting position.
Keep exactly as is: the support plates and where they touch the monocoque rear face at X=-3700 (Z 400..500, same position and size at that face); the overall X range, Y half-width and Z range (the world envelope must not grow in any direction); at least 20 mm clearance from the engine cover and the rear wheels (currently about 199 mm and 284 mm); one connected solid.
Change only the wing: (1) give the main plane and the upper flap cambered airfoil cross-sections (rounded leading edge, thin trailing edge) with a 15-25 mm slot gap between them; (2) shape the supports as slim aerodynamic plates that lean rearward towards the main plane, thicker at the monocoque and thinner at the wing, joined smoothly to the underside of the main plane; (3) make each endplate a curved plate with a rounded top edge, a swept leading edge and a shallow cut-out along its lower rear edge; (4) round all outer corners with radii of at least 5 mm. Use few loft sections and simple curves so the geometry stays robust; no tiny features below 3 mm.

revision.change_summary: Cambered main plane and flap profiles with a ~20 mm slot gap, tapered supports leaning rearward, swept endplates with a cut-out, rounded profile corners
assumptions: The outer corners are rounded by short polyline arcs in the sketch profiles (radius about 8-20 mm) instead of Fusion fillet features, to keep the build robust; the edges through the 20 mm endplate thickness stay sharp.

Each support is a 100 mm straight block from Z 400 to 500, so the contact face at X=-3700 (Y ±90..±110, Z 400..500) is unchanged. Above it is a straight two-section loft that thins from 20 mm to 12 mm and ends inside the main plane at Z 975.
The curved endplate shape comes from its side outline (curved leading edge, rounded corners). The plate itself stays flat across its thickness.
